pairs.target: chūn shì zuì rènào nàtiān , tǎ wéi zài jiēkǒu wén le bàn zǎoshàng de zhà miàn xiāng , què shǐzhōng méi zhǎodào mài miàn de rén .
pairs.english: On the spring market's busiest day, Tavi spent half the morning smelling fried dough at the street entrance, yet never found the seller.
pairs.hanzi: 春市最热闹那天，塔维在街口闻了半早上的炸面香，却始终没找到卖面的人。

pairs.target: fēng jiāng xiāngqì cóng wūdǐng sònglái , tā xún zhe zhǎo guòqù , zhī kànjiàn yìpái liàngzhe de shībù .
pairs.english: The wind brought the scent over the roofs. Following it, he found only a row of damp cloths hanging to dry.
pairs.hanzi: 风将香气从屋顶送来，他循着找过去，只看见一排晾着的湿布。

pairs.target: yù hé jiào tā huílái , shuō shǎoshù le yíliàngchē .
pairs.english: Yuhe called him back, saying he had missed a cart in his count.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾叫他回来，说少数了一辆车。

pairs.target: tā gāng yào dītóu , bèi tā lā zhù bǎnzǐ : " dòu nǐ de . nǐ zài shù , lián tuī mó lái de dōu yào gěi nǐ liúxià xìngmíng le . "
pairs.english: As he lowered his head, she caught his board. “I'm teasing. Keep counting and even the bun delivery will have to leave you a name.”
pairs.hanzi: 他刚要低头，被她拉住板子：“逗你的。你再数，连推馍来的都要给你留下姓名了。”

pairs.target: luó dí jīnrì méi lái . tā qù xiū tángxiōng jiā de tīzǐ , zuówǎn yíng zǒu tǎ wéi bànkuài táng , zǒushí hái jiānchí méiyǒu yòng shú shéng zhànpiányi .
pairs.english: Luodi had not come today. He was repairing his cousin's ladder; last night he had won half a sweet from Tavi, still insisting as he left that familiar rope had given him no advantage.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻今日没来。他去修堂兄家的梯子，昨晚赢走塔维半块糖，走时还坚持没有用熟绳占便宜。

pairs.target: dǐngtì tā lái de shì běndì mùjiàng , jiānshàng kángzhe jǐgēn duǎn gān , máng zhe tì tānzhǔ zhī qǐ xīn péng .
pairs.english: A local carpenter had come in his place, carrying short poles on his shoulder, busy erecting a new awning for a stallholder.
pairs.hanzi: 顶替他来的是本地木匠，肩上扛着几根短杆，忙着替摊主支起新棚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāng tā xiè le yìgēn , mùjiàng biàn shùnshǒu bǎ lìngyìtóu dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi helped unload one, and the carpenter promptly handed him the other end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮他卸了一根，木匠便顺手把另一头递给他。

pairs.target: zhè huó kànzhe jiǎndān , zhànwěn hòu què téng bù chūshǒu .
pairs.english: The job looked simple, but once firmly positioned he had no hand free.
pairs.hanzi: 这活看着简单，站稳后却腾不出手。

pairs.target: mùjiàng dào duìmiàn zhǎo shéng , tǎ wéi jǔ zhe gān , yǎnkàn nà gǔ zhà miàn xiāng yòu piāoguòlái , shēnbiān mǎi suān guǒ de xiǎohái zhèng ná liǎngméi qián huàn yídà bǎ , zìjǐ lián zhuā yíxià bízi dōu bù fāngbiàn .
pairs.english: The carpenter went across for rope. Tavi held the pole as the fried-dough scent drifted past again; a child beside him was trading two coins for a big handful of sour fruit, while he could barely scratch his nose.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠到对面找绳，塔维举着杆，眼看那股炸面香又飘过来，身边买酸果的小孩正拿两枚钱换一大把，自己连抓一下鼻子都不方便。

pairs.target: " nǐ bāng tā dǐng dào sàn shì ? "
pairs.english: “Are you holding that for him until the market ends?”
pairs.hanzi: “你帮他顶到散市？”

pairs.target: bēilǒu nǚrén cóng shíjiē shànglái , tíng zài gān qián .
pairs.english: The basket-carrying woman came up the stone steps and stopped before the pole.
pairs.hanzi: 背篓女人从石阶上来，停在杆前。

pairs.target: tā jīnrì chuān le jiàn tuìsè lányī , lǒu dǐ pù zhe shībù , lǐmiàn shì gěi rǎnfáng sòng de fàn guàn .
pairs.english: Today she wore a faded blue garment; damp cloth lined her basket beneath food pots for the dye works.
pairs.hanzi: 她今日穿了件褪色蓝衣，篓底铺着湿布，里面是给染坊送的饭罐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děng mùjiàng huílái , huà méi shuōwán , péngbù hūdì chī mǎn fēng , yìgǔ lì zhuài dé tā wǎngqián kuà le bànbù .
pairs.english: Tavi said he was waiting for the carpenter, but before he finished, wind suddenly filled the awning, pulling him half a step forward.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说等木匠回来，话没说完，棚布忽地吃满风，一股力拽得他往前跨了半步。

pairs.target: nǚrén lìkè fàngxià lǒu , zhuāzhù gān xiàduān , jiào tā bié yìng wǎnghuí chě .
pairs.english: The woman immediately set her basket down, grabbed the pole's lower end, and told him not to yank back against it.
pairs.hanzi: 女人立刻放下篓，抓住杆下端，叫他别硬往回扯。

pairs.target: mùjiàng cóng rénqún lǐ jǐ lái , liǎng rén xiān jiàngxià yìjiǎo , fēng cái cóng bù biān táochūqù .
pairs.english: The carpenter squeezed through the crowd. They lowered one corner first, letting the wind escape at the cloth's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠从人群里挤来，两人先降下一角，风才从布边逃出去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎngxīn mó dé fārè , méiyǒu nàzhǒng jiè xìng hòufā mù de gǎnjué , zhǐshì wò dé tàijǐn . tā huàn le zhī shǒu , mǒ qù bíjiān de hàn .
pairs.english: Tavi's palms burned from friction, without the numbness that followed property borrowing; he had simply gripped too tightly. He changed hands and wiped the sweat off his nose.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维掌心磨得发热，没有那种借性后发木的感觉，只是握得太紧。他换了只手，抹去鼻尖的汗。

pairs.target: mùjiàng yào bǎ shéng qiān dào shíjiē biān de jiù huán shàng . nǚrén jiǎoxià yídòng , dǎngzhù le : " nǐ zhèyàng yì lā , wǒ de lǒu jiù guòbúqù le . "
pairs.english: The carpenter meant to run the rope to an old ring beside the steps. The woman stepped in his way. “Stretch it like that and my basket won't get through.”
pairs.hanzi: 木匠要把绳牵到石阶边的旧环上。女人脚下一动，挡住了：“你这样一拉，我的篓就过不去了。”

pairs.target: " děnghuìer xì gāo xiē . "
pairs.english: “I'll tie it higher in a moment.”
pairs.hanzi: “等会儿系高些。”

pairs.target: " gāo dào nǐ de tóushàng , háishì gāo dào lǒu shàng ? " tā zhǐzhe bēilǒu , " wǒ wānyāo de shíhòu , tā yě búhuì gēnzhe suō . "
pairs.english: “Above your head, or above the basket?” She pointed to her basket. “When I bend down, it doesn't shrink with me.”
pairs.hanzi: “高到你的头上，还是高到篓上？”她指着背篓，“我弯腰的时候，它也不会跟着缩。”

pairs.target: mùjiàng zhòu zhe méi kàn le yìyǎn rénliú , méi mǎshàng gǎi .
pairs.english: The carpenter frowned at the flow of people and did not change it immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠皱着眉看了一眼人流，没马上改。

pairs.target: péng xià mài bù de gūniáng cuī tā , shuō huò cái pūkāi , zǒng bùnéng shài dào bàngwǎn , yòu wèn nǚrén néng bunéng jīntiān rào lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: The young cloth seller beneath the awning urged him on: her goods were just laid out and could not sit in the sun until evening. Could the woman go around the other way today?
pairs.hanzi: 棚下卖布的姑娘催他，说货才铺开，总不能晒到傍晚，又问女人能不能今天绕另一边。

pairs.target: nǚrén xiānkāi lǒu bù , lùchū sìgè fàn guàn , shuō háiyǒu dìèrtàng , rào qù chē biān , tāng fān le , shuí tì tā sòng .
pairs.english: The woman lifted the basket cloth, revealing four food pots. She had a second trip too; if she went around beside the carts and spilled the soup, who would deliver it for her?
pairs.hanzi: 女人掀开篓布，露出四个饭罐，说还有第二趟，绕去车边，汤翻了，谁替她送。

pairs.target: fēng yòu lái , gūniáng gǎnjǐn jiāng bù yāzhù .
pairs.english: The wind came again; the young woman hurriedly weighed down the cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 风又来，姑娘赶紧将布压住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jǔ zhe gān , yuánxiān xiǎng shuō de yíjù " hěnkuài jiù hǎo " kǎ zài zuǐlǐ .
pairs.english: Holding the pole, Tavi found the words “It'll soon be done” stuck in his mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维举着杆，原先想说的一句“很快就好”卡在嘴里。

pairs.target: tā cóng zhèlǐ kàn chūqù , dìyīcì fāxiànzìjǐ zhàn de wèizhì zhènghǎo zài shíjiē kǒu zhōngyāng , lián méi bēilǒu de rén yě dé cèshēn jǐ .
pairs.english: Looking out from here, he realized for the first time that his position was right in the middle of the steps' entrance; even people without baskets had to squeeze sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 他从这里看出去，第一次发现自己占的位置正好在石阶口中央，连没背篓的人也得侧身挤。

pairs.target: " lǐtou nàgēn néng wǎnghòu fàng ma ? " tā wèn mùjiàng , zhǐ de shì pù ménpáng de kòngdì , " wǒ xiān dǐng zhe , nǐ jìnqù kànkàn . "
pairs.english: “Can the inner pole go farther back?” he asked the carpenter, pointing to the space beside the shop door. “I'll hold this while you look inside.”
pairs.hanzi: “里头那根能往后放吗？”他问木匠，指的是铺门旁的空地，“我先顶着，你进去看看。”

pairs.target: gūniáng shuō nàlǐ háiyào bǎi huò . mùjiàng fàngxià shéng , wèn tā liú bànshàn mén xíngbùxíng , bié zài wǎng wài tiān dìèrpái .
pairs.english: The seller said she needed that space for goods. The carpenter set the rope down and asked if half a doorway would do, with no second row added outside.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘说那里还要摆货。木匠放下绳，问她留半扇门行不行，别再往外添第二排。

pairs.target: sāngè rén bǐ zhe gān cháng nuó le yícì , réng jǐ , zuìhòu jiāng liǎngpǐ bù dié huí xiāng lǐ , péng cái wǎng lǐ shōu le bànbù .
pairs.english: The three shifted it once against the pole's length, but it was still cramped. Finally two lengths of cloth were folded back into the chest, and the awning moved half a step inward.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人比着杆长挪了一次，仍挤，最后将两匹布叠回箱里，棚才往里收了半步。

pairs.target: shéng gǎi xì pù nèi de mùzhù , lìngjiā xié chēng , búzài héngguò shíjiē .
pairs.english: The rope was retied to a wooden post inside the shop, with an extra diagonal brace, no longer crossing the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 绳改系铺内的木柱，另加斜撑，不再横过石阶。

pairs.target: mùjiàng yònglì yáo le jǐxià , jiào tǎ wéi sōngshǒu zhàn kāi . péng huàng le huàng , méi wǎng wài pǎo .
pairs.english: The carpenter shook it hard a few times and told Tavi to let go and stand back. The awning swayed but did not move outward.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠用力摇了几下，叫塔维松手站开。棚晃了晃，没往外跑。

pairs.target: nǚrén bèi qǐ lǒu shì guò , fàn guàn qīngqīng pèng chū xiǎng , tā huítóu shuō zìjǐ jiào bì lán , jiù zhù xià tóu rǎnfáng hòuyuàn ; xiàwǔ háiyǒu liǎngtàng , ruò shéng zài héng chūlái , tā hái huì lái zhǎo rén .
pairs.english: The woman tried carrying her basket through, the food pots clinking softly. Turning back, she said her name was Bilan and she lived in the dye works' rear courtyard below. She had two more trips this afternoon; if the rope crossed the way again, she would come find them.
pairs.hanzi: 女人背起篓试过，饭罐轻轻碰出响，她回头说自己叫碧岚，就住下头染坊后院；下午还有两趟，若绳再横出来，她还会来找人。

pairs.target: mài bù gūniáng hēng le yìshēng , zhuǎntóu què tì tā xiānqǐ bù jiǎo , ràng lǒu xiān guò .
pairs.english: The cloth seller snorted but turned to lift the cloth's corner for her, letting the basket through first.
pairs.hanzi: 卖布姑娘哼了一声，转头却替她掀起布角，让篓先过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi róu zhuóshǒu , juéde bàntiáo gēbo dōu shì biérén de .
pairs.english: Tavi rubbed his hands, feeling as though half his arm belonged to someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维揉着手，觉得半条胳膊都是别人的。

pairs.target: mùjiàng jiāng shèngxià de gān bānzǒu , línzǒu shuō xiàhuí xiān wèn tā néng zhàn duōjiǔ , zìjǐ máng qǐlái , zhēn huì bǎ tā dāng gēn zhùzi wàng zài nàér .
pairs.english: The carpenter took away the remaining poles. Leaving, he said next time he would ask how long Tavi could stand there; when busy, he really might mistake him for a post and forget him.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠将剩下的杆搬走，临走说下回先问他能站多久，自己忙起来，真会把他当根柱子忘在那儿。

pairs.target: kuài dào wǔfàn shí , nà gūniáng cóng pù lǐ chūlái , gěi tǎ wéi sāi le gè yóu zhǐbāo , shuō fāngcái zhǐgù kànhuò , wàng le tā hái dǐng zhe .
pairs.english: Near lunchtime the young seller came out of the shop and pressed an oiled-paper parcel on Tavi, saying she had been so absorbed in the goods that she forgot he was still holding the pole.
pairs.hanzi: 快到午饭时，那姑娘从铺里出来，给塔维塞了个油纸包，说方才只顾看货，忘了他还顶着。

pairs.target: lǐmiàn zhèngshì zhà miàn , yǐjīng bùzěnme tàng le . tā yìkǒu yǎo xiàqù , suì zhā diào le mǎn jīn .
pairs.english: Inside was the fried dough, no longer very hot. He bit into it, scattering crumbs all over his front.
pairs.hanzi: 里面正是炸面，已经不怎么烫了。他一口咬下去，碎渣掉了满襟。

pairs.target: yù hé kànjiàn , wèn tā zhōngyú zhǎodào xiāngqì cóng nǎér lái le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Yuhe saw and asked whether he had finally found where the scent came from.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾看见，问他终于找到香气从哪儿来了没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi pěng zhe zhǐbāo , hánhudì shuō zhǎodào le , jiùshì ménkǒu bùhǎo zhǎo , xiān dé bānzǒu bàngè tānzi .
pairs.english: Cradling the parcel, Tavi mumbled that he had found it; the entrance was hard to locate, though, and first you had to move half a stall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维捧着纸包，含糊地说找到了，就是门口不好找，先得搬走半个摊子。
